description: This file defines a logging subsystem for a software project, including a SubsystemLogger type, functions to create loggers, and runtime environments for logging. It manages console and file logging, message formatting, and subsystem-specific color coding.

classes.name: SubsystemLogger
classes.description: Interface for subsystem-specific loggers with methods for different log levels and child loggers.

methods.name: shouldLogToConsole
methods.description: Determines if a message at a given log level should be logged to the console based on settings.

methods.name: formatRuntimeArg
methods.description: Formats a runtime argument into a string, using inspection or JSON serialization.

methods.name: isRichConsoleEnv
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports rich console features like colors.

methods.name: getColorForConsole
methods.description: Determines the appropriate Chalk color level for console output based on environment.

methods.name: pickSubsystemColor
methods.description: Selects a color for a subsystem, with overrides and hashing for consistency.

methods.name: formatSubsystemForConsole
methods.description: Formats subsystem strings for console display, dropping prefixes and limiting segments.

methods.name: stripRedundantSubsystemPrefixForConsole
methods.description: Removes redundant subsystem prefixes from log messages.

methods.name: formatConsoleLine
methods.description: Creates a formatted console log line with timestamp, subsystem, level, and message.

methods.name: writeConsoleLine
methods.description: Outputs a log line to the console or error stream, handling platform specifics.

methods.name: shouldSuppressProbeConsoleLine
methods.description: Determines if a probe-related console line should be suppressed based on verbosity and message content.

methods.name: logToFile
methods.description: Logs a message to a file logger with appropriate level and metadata.

methods.name: createSubsystemLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger object for a specific subsystem with methods for logging at various levels.

methods.name: runtimeForLogger
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment for a given logger, with methods for logging, writing stdout, JSON, and exiting.

methods.name: createSubsystemRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment for a subsystem, wrapping a subsystem logger.
